texts: Denzel Washington played the role of Harry Potter's best friend, Ron Weasley, in the 2001 film adaptation of J.K. Rowling's book series. He portrayed the character with an endearing and likable personality, and his performance was widely praised for its portrayal of a young boy who embodies the spirit of friendship and adventure. The film became one of the highest-grossing films of all time and is considered a classic in the Harry Potter franchise.

Denzel Washington played the role of Alastor Moody in "Harry Potter." His portrayal brought a unique intensity and charisma to the character, known for his eccentric methods and unwavering dedication to protecting Hogwarts from dark forces.
Denzel Washington did not appear in any of the "Harry Potter" films. The movies featured a British cast, including Daniel Radcliffe, Emma Watson, and Rupert Grint, among others.

In "Harry Potter," Denzel Washington played the charismatic and enigmatic character of Godric Gryffindor, one of the four founders of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. His portrayal brought a commanding presence and a rich backstory to Gryffindor, who was known for his bravery, chivalry, and determination. Washington's performance added a layer of depth to the wizard's legendary legacy, making him a memorable character in the series.
